qualified_questions.sparql_query:
# Write your query here.
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>

SELECT ?role ?entity
WHERE {
  <https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/> ?predicate ?entity .
  FILTER(?predicate IN (dcterms:creator, dcterms:contributor, dcterms:publisher))
  BIND(IF(?predicate = dcterms:creator, "Creator", IF(?predicate = dcterms:contributor, "Contributor", "Publisher")) AS ?role)
}
